text.aria-label: Subtitle text '6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; pooled mixture of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds (99.58% for C1 to C6, 95% for the post hoc P1). Orange: the two contrasts that decide the verdict. Black dashed line: no change.'
text.tspan: 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; pooled mixture
Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds (99.58% for C1 to C6, 95% for
the post hoc P1). Orange: the two contrasts that decide the verdict. Black dashed line: no change.
